title: Build Support Console panel
verified: support.bundle status now renders TUI Support Console without exporting a bundle.
support.bundle export writes the redacted bundle through typed command dispatch.
Support Console renders runtime health, audit status, ecosystem state and release evidence summary.
Support Console identifies degraded runtime/support/ecosystem state.
Remote audit mirror state is visible while local audit remains authoritative.
Support bundle manifest stays deterministic and redacted.
Support Console preserves existing TUI Support Bundle marker for runbook compatibility.
risk_notes: Support Console is a projection panel and does not own runtime, audit, resolver or side-effect authority.
Support export remains bound to typed support.bundle export dispatch.
Remote mirror is displayed as diagnostics only and is not recovery authority.
